recommended_cuts.rationale: File 'src/services/user.service.ts' only references type definitions (UserModel) from 'src/models/user.model.ts'. Converting to 'import type' or isolated declarations eliminates runtime circularity.
actionable_steps: Change import in 'src/services/user.service.ts' to: import type { UserModel } from 'src/models/user.model.ts'.
Ensure TypeScript compiler option 'isolatedDeclarations' or 'verbatimModuleSyntax' is satisfied.

recommended_cuts.rationale: Architectural layer violation: Other 'src/services/data.processor.ts' (layer 2) imports higher-level Service 'src/services/user.service.ts' (layer 3). Dependencies should flow downward.
actionable_steps: Refactor 'src/services/data.processor.ts' to remove the direct upward dependency on 'src/services/user.service.ts'.
Extract shared data structures or callbacks so 'src/services/data.processor.ts' operates on primitives or interfaces.
Pass 'src/services/user.service.ts' or its methods to 'src/services/data.processor.ts' via dependency injection or function arguments.
